hints.title: Column Coordinate Level Order
hints.text: Assign column coordinate zero to root and traverse downward layer by layer to preserve top-to-bottom order within each column.

hints.title: Queue with Position Pairs
hints.text: Enqueue pairs of (node, col). Decrement col for left child and increment col for right child.

hints.title: Column Grouped Breadth-First Collection
hints.text: Use a breadth traversal queue storing (node, col). Append node values to a dictionary keyed by column. Track min_col and max_col. After BFS finishes, extract arrays from min_col to max_col.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear breadth-first column grouping preserving natural vertical and horizontal ordering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: DFS traversal requires extra row sorting to preserve top-to-bottom vertical order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: BFS automatically guarantees top-to-bottom ordering within each column without sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use BFS so nodes on the same vertical line appear in their top-to-bottom level order.
